title: Non-MCMC Constraints on the EFC α-Parameter: BAO, Growth-Rate, and Cluster Evidence
description: Validation note reporting non-MCMC constraints on the EFC α-parameter using DESI Y1 and BOSS DR12 BAO, multi-epoch growth-rate (fσ8), IllustrisTNG cluster statistics, and cosmic chronometer H(z) data. Cross-validation and likelihood-ratio tests show a consistent directional preference for EFC over ΛCDM (e.g., Δχ2DESI = −22.01; Δχ2BOSS = −7.77) and a growth-derived indication α = −1.00 ± 0.46 (2.20σ), while concurrent MCMC remains degeneracy-limited. Results are framed as model-comparison metrics (not posteriors) and compared against pre-registered sealed predictions.

delta_chi2.description: Likelihood-ratio metric used for model comparison; negative values indicate preference for EFC over ΛCDM.

aic_difference.description: Information-criterion comparison accounting for parsimony; negative values favor EFC. For BOSS DR12, keff = 0.

reduced_chi2.description: Goodness-of-fit per degree of freedom; values near 1 indicate adequate fit, values near 0 can indicate overfitting or inflated errors.

z_significance.description: Significance of the inferred α relative to a reference α0 (often 0), expressed in Gaussian σ units; used for growth-derived indication (2.20σ).

fs8_definition.description: Product of the linear growth rate f(z) and the rms matter fluctuation amplitude σ8(z); multi-epoch measurements constrain growth-sector responses to α.

key_results.main_finding: Non-MCMC model-comparison metrics consistently prefer EFC over ΛCDM in BAO and growth probes (Δχ2DESI = −22.01; Δχ2BOSS = −7.77; α = −1.00 ± 0.46 from fσ8), while MCMC posteriors remain degeneracy-limited and uninformative for α.
datasets_used: fσ8 multi-epoch compiled catalogue (7 epochs, LOO 7/7)

sealed_predictions.statement: Sealed prior-prediction for the EFC α-parameter: α = −0.702 (NUTS).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A robust, validated constraint showing α inconsistent with −0.702 by >3σ (posterior or cross-validated estimate) across multiple independent probes.

sealed_predictions.statement: Sealed prior-prediction for the EFC α-parameter: α = −0.689 (NUTS).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A robust, validated constraint showing α inconsistent with −0.689 by >3σ across BAO and growth datasets with audited covariances.

kill_criteria: KC1: Cross-validated BAO (DESI final + BOSS DR12/extended) yield Δχ2 ≥ +10 in favor of ΛCDM over EFC in at least two independent BAO compilations using audited covariances.
KC2: Growth-sector tests (RSD fσ8 with ≥10 independent redshift bins) return α consistent with 0 at |α|/σα < 1 and show LOO preference ≤2/10 for EFC (i.e., majority preference for ΛCDM).
KC3: Joint information-criterion comparison across BAO + growth + lensing (if included) penalizes EFC with ΔAIC_total ≥ +10 relative to ΛCDM under matched keff.
KC4: Degeneracy-resolved MCMC (using next-generation datasets and validated priors) yields α = 0.00 ± 0.10 (68% C.L.) or tighter, consistent across samplers (NUTS/EMCEE) and starting points.
KC5: Independent, audited cluster statistics (observational, not proxy) with realistic DOF and covariances produce χ2red ≈ 1 for ΛCDM and a statistically significant degradation for EFC (p < 0.01).
KC6: Consistency checks show sealed α-predictions disagreed by >3σ with multiple non-MCMC and MCMC constraints that are mutually consistent with ΛCDM (α ≈ 0) after blinding and validation.

related_packages.role: Cross-referenced validation for BOSS DR12 BAO non-MCMC result propagation.
Cross-referenced validation for multi-epoch fσ8 growth-sector analysis.
